summary.en-US: Switch proxy profiles in one click. Keep page-visible location, timezone and WebRTC settings together, with clear identity diagnostics. For Firefox desktop.

version.approval_notes:
Reviewer notes for the 1.1.5 listed metadata-fix release are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md and docs/PRIVACY.md in the accompanying tagged source archive. Runtime behavior is unchanged from immutable v1.1.4: https://github.com/jacek4yang/net-identity/tree/4d99c9a0eeeb3217ae9c8fd32dbcbdd428dc1370 . That attempted submission failed before an AMO version existed; its 4,527-character notes exceeded the server model limit of 3,000. No pending Mozilla review is being bypassed. The tag and draft evidence remain unchanged.

Firefox desktop minimum 140.0, no maximum. Schema 4 removes durable proxy usernames and preserves applied configuration independently of saved edits. Username/password are session-only. Required locationInfo/authenticationInfo and optional personallyIdentifyingInfo accurately declare existing transmission; update consent may change. Save does not activate; Apply commits the saved revision. Blank credential fields keep the session pair; Duplicate copies neither secret.

Selected proxy routing has terminal-null protection and no Direct fallback. Unsafe routes or missing required credentials block ordinary extension-observable traffic. Firefox-protected services cannot all be canceled. HTTP proxies must reject anonymous clients for account identity: configured credentials do not prove authentication when no 407 challenge occurs. Passive SOCKS health is bounded evidence, not proof of outage; it never replays HTTP or changes identity/route. This is not a universal kill switch.

The coordinate picker starts offline. Load online map explicitly enables OpenFreeMap data for that editor session, disclosing viewed region and visible egress IP to provider/CDN. Direct/Off requires optional IP consent. Unsafe routes, missing required credentials and provider bypasses deny loading. The bounded background broker validates HTTPS resources, rejects redirects, omits cookies/referrers/explicit proxy credentials and cancels stale sessions.

MapLibre 6.11.2 renderer, CSS, worker and notices are bundled locally. Reproducible source-hash checks replace the complete external worker-plugin loader with a denial stub. No remote executable code, RTL plugin or native GeolocateControl. CJK glyphs use brokered provider data. Renderer fanout is bounded to 8 active/256 waiting with a 60-second queue-inclusive deadline, no response-byte cache or retry. Manual coordinates remain usable on failure. See docs/TILE-POLICY.md and scripts/vendor/README.md for source/build details.

Unsigned candidate screenshots are UI evidence only. Publication still requires exact AMO approval, signed-XPI hash/payload verification and permanent signature-enforcing stable Firefox installation. Existing historical versions and submissions remain unchanged.
